title: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal: refreshed Analytics & Reports navigation
summary: The planned navigation changes, rollout window and existing controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. Minor corrections should narrow the licensing summary to room reports, retain the qualification about incidental user references in logs, and remove the checklist's unmatched Log history control.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to reorganise Analytics & Reports in the Pro Management portal to make it more user-friendly.
claims.quote: We are refreshing the way we organize the Analytics & Reports area in the Pro Management portal to make it more user-friendly.

claims.claim: The refresh introduces an updated design and simplified navigation.
claims.quote: The Analytics & Reports experience will receive a refreshed design and simplified navigation.

claims.claim: A Room analytics entry point will appear in the left navigation.
claims.quote: New Room analytics and Desk analytics entry points will appear in the left navigation.

claims.claim: A Desk analytics entry point will appear in the left navigation.
claims.quote: New Room analytics and Desk analytics entry points will appear in the left navigation.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The supplied notice describes design, navigation and renaming, without describing new data collection, identity permissions or autonomous actions.
claims.quote: The Analytics & Reports experience will receive a refreshed design and simplified navigation. Existing reports will move to their respective Room analytics or Desk analytics pages. Recommended Actions will be renamed to Recommendations.

claims.claim: Pro Management data is specific to a room account, not an individual user.
claims.quote: Data collected is specific to a room account, not an individual user. Incidental references to an individual user may be present in the activity log during use of the device.
claims.fix: Add immediately after this statement: 'Incidental references to an individual user may be present in the activity log during use of the device.' This qualification is in https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-pro-management.

claims.claim: The Pro Management service does not access live meeting content.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro management service doesn't access the live content of a meeting.

claims.quote: Recommended Actions adheres to role-based access controls in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, displaying rooms the user is authorized to view.

claims.claim: Shared Spaces Insights displays utilisation only for spaces the user is authorised to view under portal RBAC.
claims.quote: Shared Spaces Insights adheres to role-based access controls in the Pro Management portal, displaying utilization metrics only for spaces the user is authorized to view.

claims.claim: Portal role assignments determine users' access to room resource data and the rooms they can see.
claims.quote: Role-based access control (RBAC) in the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal helps you manage user access to room resource data in your organization. By assigning roles to your portal users, you can limit what they can see and change.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to check Log history, but the controls table has no row for that monitoring control.
claims.quote: Check the Meeting space optimization recommendations setting and its entry under Settings > General > Log history. The table lists only refresh opt-out, portal roles and the recommendations setting.
claims.fix: Replace the After rollout bullet with 'Check the Meeting space optimization recommendations setting to confirm it is as you recorded it.' This removes the unmatched Log history checklist control without adding a table row.

claims.claim: Rooms hidden from the address book are excluded from Shared Spaces Insights and Recommended Actions.
claims.quote: Rooms that are hidden from the address book are not included in Shared Spaces Insights and Recommended Actions pages. Specifically, the “HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled” must be set to false for the room resource account mailbox for the room to be included.
